Pathogen x Candidate-Panel x Hospital Feasibility Table

Source: R/profile_eligibility.R
profile_check_panel_feasibility.Rd

Builds the feasibility table the way profile_precision_bound says it has to be built: the n_min benchmark is computed ONCE per candidate panel (shared across strata), and checked against each stratum's OWN complete-event count for that exact panel. There is no aggregation step, no coverage-fraction cutoff, and no auto-selected "best" panel size – this reports meets_benchmark per pathogen-panel-stratum row and leaves the choice of how many classes to use, per pathogen, to be made by inspecting that table (together with profile_plan_precision's Wilson/Goodman widths and clinical judgment about which classes matter), not by this function.

Usage

profile_check_panel_feasibility(
  data,
  group_col,
  candidate_panels,
  class_col = NULL,
  value_col = "antibiotic_value",
  resistant_values = c("R", "Resistant", "resistant"),
  susceptible_values = c("S", "Susceptible", "susceptible"),
  intermediate_values = c("I", "Intermediate", "intermediate"),
  event_id_col = NULL,
  epsilon,
  alpha = 0.05,
  simultaneous_across_groups = FALSE,
  unknown_action = c("error", "treat_as_untested"),
  conflict_action = c("error", "drop_conflicts", "resistant_wins", "susceptible_wins",
    "first")
)

Arguments

data, group_col, class_col, value_col, resistant_values, susceptible_values, intermediate_values, event_id_col

Passed through to profile_audit_support once per candidate panel (its class_cols argument is the candidate panel itself).

candidate_panels

A named list of character vectors, each a candidate set of classes to evaluate (e.g. list(core4 = c("Carbapenems","Fluoroquinolones","Penicillins", "Aminoglycosides"), alt4 = c(...))). Unnamed entries are labelled panel_1, panel_2, ...

epsilon, alpha

Passed to profile_precision_bound.

simultaneous_across_groups

Logical. When TRUE, applies the Bonferroni correction across the number of groups found for each panel (a joint guarantee across all of them). Default FALSE (each group checked against its own 1 - alpha guarantee).

unknown_action, conflict_action

Same meaning as in profile_audit_support, passed through once per candidate panel – the same AST policy is applied to every panel being screened.

Value

A data frame, one row per candidate panel x group: panel, classes, D, K, group, n_complete, n_min, meets_benchmark.

Details

candidate_panels is supplied explicitly, never auto-generated: a panel of a given size is not interchangeable with any other same-size panel (A-B-C-D and A-B-D-E can have very different joint support even at the same D), so which combinations to test is a decision for the caller – a clinically pre-screened shortlist, or an exhaustive enumeration the caller builds and passes in.
